summary: Updates the conceptual sending algorithm in RFC 2461 so that an IPv6 host can share traffic among equivalent routers for different destinations. The original algorithm did not do load sharing and suggested schemes that were problematic in practice. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: If there are several doors out of a room, don't send everyone through just one. This helps a host spread its traffic over several routers.

questions: ipv6 host to router load sharing
